title: Anyone using Meta's Muse models for game development?
author: dnr424
selftext: Has anyone tried Muse models for game development? How's your experience so far, especially with coding, game design, and asset creation? And also the usage.

comments.author: BoringPossum
comments.body: No. Just use Claude and gpt

replies.author: dnr424
replies.body: Yes I'm using GPT & claude. But I saw Meta is offering 5x more usage for Muse on 15$ plan. I'm wondering if I should try once.

replies.author: BoringPossum
replies.body: If you're asking you aren't making games that require sota models. If it's cheaper and suits your usage try it👍🏻 they probably overlap a bit if you get it now so you know to cancel or to not cancel your other subs

comments.author: Designisty
comments.body: Do not bother, I have tried every modle including open weights and a few local ones that can run on my PC and nothing still comes close to OpenAI or Claude stick with them for now.  And yes this is for Game Dev also, currently building 2 games one is Godot and one is UE5.

replies.author: dnr424
replies.body: I'm hoping the next models in the Sol and Opus series will be cheaper.

replies.author: Designisty
replies.body: According to rumors, 6.2 Sol is meant to be 60% cheaper. For me, most of the general game dev stuff can be done on Medium; I use High / XHigh when building up new mechanics, while Medium is good for making tweaks and polishing. I am using two Plus accounts, and it seems to be enough for me at the moment.

replies.author: Great_Teacher400
replies.body: Sol sucks. Try terra medium. It works well

comments.author: DetectiveExisting803
comments.body: I really want to try carbon but it’s no public yet …

replies.author: dnr424
replies.body: Gpt sol 5 hour usage is more than Gemini argon weekly usage on a 20$ plan. So, carbon usage limit will be way worse.

comments.author: CrowdGoesWildWoooo
comments.body: Most of the value of the model is in post train stage. Let’s just say Meta is not at the point where it has the same amount of breadth as frontier labs in terms of tasks in post training.

comments.author: maxneuds
comments.body: I only use claude but I am looking into setting up Claude Code with LiteLLM to add an unlimited Deepseek sub to it such that Deepseek can do implementation to save tokens on claude.
